name: lubricant-website-monorepo
_readme: This root package.json is just a set of shortcuts so you don't have to 'cd' into the frontend or backend folders. The real React app (and its real dependencies) live in ./frontend. The optional contact-form email server lives in ./backend/server. Run 'npm run install:all' once, then 'npm run dev' to start developing. See README.md for full instructions.

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix backend/server
